items.content:
Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
GAME: 2D metroidvania; play Hornet (red cloak, needle). HUD: 1/5 masks (CRITICAL), silk EMPTY, 20 shards.

CONTROLS: Left/Right walk; Z jump; Up+dir+Z climbs walls/vines; X attack (also reveals hidden Hornet); C dash = no effect; A bind = no effect with empty silk.

FREEZES (37 so far, very frequent): identical frame after input = freeze. Fix: click at (0.3,0.8); often needs click, movement, then second click. Some resolve with one click. Some need wait. Shifting particles/HUD wisp or camera pan = running. Inputs during freeze may register late. Hornet often hidden behind dark foreground; walk Left or press X to reveal. After a click, an unchanged frame proves nothing; test with movement input.

MAP:
- CAGE CAVERN: woven cage (background, not standable, has golden knob) with golden stake at base (~(0.66,0.77)); tall black mushrooms; mossy right wall. Paved path west leads (via mossy light-shaft corridor with vines/stalactite) to light-shaft chamber. East at ground level/behind foreground leads to east pocket. RIGHT-WALL CLIMB at x~0.84-0.9: chain ~4-5 Up+Right+Z -> transitions to EAST POCKET (confirmed multiple times), NOT to bell chamber reliably.
- LIGHT-SHAFT CHAMBER: lower floor, raised mossy terrace with stone post at left (~(0.33,0.62)), green light shafts, hanging stalactites. Upper-west shelf reachable via Left+Z onto terrace, then Up+Left+Z. Dead ends: braided vine pillar, west vine column (unbreakable, blocks Left at x~0.15), shelf ceiling, lowest floor west (blocked by terrace front), Down on terrace.
- BELL CHAMBER: reached once earlier via right-wall climb (inconsistent route); bell shattered for +10 shards; vine curtain/east pillars dead ends.
- EAST POCKET: green light, hanging moss, rubble at center with pale shell shapes (~(0.56-0.64,0.70-0.74); possibly dormant enemies, unconfirmed). Cobblestone column x~0.77 with dark pillars blocks east at ground. Red coral scenery on column at ~(0.77,0.51). Small green glow at (0.96,0.64). Exit west: walk Left to x~0.27 -> cage cavern (confirmed). ROUTE UP TO PALE-CREATURE CHAMBER: from east pocket floor/rubble, Up+Right+Z launches Hornet high to ~(0.88,0.22) near gap level; from there Up+Left+Z may reach gap at ~(0.72,0.25). Earlier attempts with Right+Z then Up+Right+Z failed to gain height; starting with Up+Right+Z from rubble is key.
- PALE-CREATURE CHAMBER: hostile pale two-eyed shell creature that rolls to charge; 2 masks per contact hit; front slashes did no visible damage; jumping over its roll failed. AVOID at 1 mask until can attempt Down+X air slashes.

FAILED/DON'T RETRY: attacking/Up at cage; cage-top landing; east beyond bell chamber; rubble/column attacks; west vine column; braided pillar; shelf ceiling; hanging moss; mushroom caps; C dash; A bind; Down drop-throughs at terrace/cage; fighting pale creature without heals or new tactics; walking east past east-pocket column; Right+Z then Up+Right+Z climb from east pocket rubble (does not gain height).

CURRENT STATUS: In east pocket after Up+Right+Z from near rubble; Hornet's position after that last input unknown (likely airborne or hidden). 1/5 masks (CRITICAL), silk EMPTY, 20 shards.

ACTIVE GOAL: Reach pale-creature chamber and attempt Down+X aerial slashes while jumping over creature's roll. Accept risk of dying since respawning may restore health. No health restores (bench/item) found in explored areas (light-shaft chamber, cage cavern, east pocket).

KEY DISCOVERED ROUTES:
- Cage cavern right-wall climb (chain Up+Right+Z at x~0.84-0.9) -> east pocket transition (confirmed multiple times).
- East pocket to pale creature: Up+Right+Z directly from rubble at ~(0.67,0.62) launches high to ~(0.88,0.22), then steer with Up+Left+Z or Left toward gap at ~(0.72,0.25).

UNRESOLVED: silk gain method (hypothesis: defeat enemies); health restore location unknown; black segmented object ~(0.45,0.63) near terrace; small green glows at (0.175,0.985) and (0.56,0.545); why bell chamber route is inconsistent; whether Down+X works on pale creature.
